elaine (secops): Auditor wants concrete proof of emergency admin access and KMS key usage during the 2026-02-18 incident. Need minimal deliverables they can ingest.
raj (platform): Which incident ID? I can pull CloudTrail/GCP Audit logs if you confirm scope.
elaine (secops): INC-2026-0218-07 — production inference nodes. They specifically asked for: who requested access, what keys were used, TTL/grant records, and chain-of-custody for any artifacts.
simon (compliance): Also include change-approval tickets and the ephemeral access justification (slack thread + pager duty notes). Auditor asked for tamper-evident checksums for exported logs.
auditor_jane: Hi — a timeline + signed hashes is enough. Prefer CSV manifest and the raw export. CSV with columns: timestamp, principal, action, resource, request_id, correlation_id. MD5 or SHA256 for each export.
raj (platform): OK. I’ll run a SIEM query and export. SIEM query (Splunk example):
```
index=cloud_audit OR index=cloudtrail action=(kms:Decrypt OR kms:GenerateDataKey OR iam:AssumeRole) resource=projects/redwood-* OR arn:aws:kms:* | stats values(user) as users, values(request_id) as rids by resource, _time | sort _time
```
I'll include GCP Audit log equivalent.
elaine (secops): Add a filter for grants created with a lifetime < 1h (ephemeral grants). auditor asked to see that TTL policy was followed.
raj (platform): For KMS audit exports I'll capture: grantCreate/grantRevoke, crypto:Encrypt/Decrypt, keyVersion used. Example CloudTrail snippet we'll export: 
```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-02-18T14:12:03Z",
  "eventName": "GenerateDataKey",
  "userIdentity": {"arn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops-emergency"},
  "requestParameters": {"keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"},
  "eventID": "e5f2-..."
}
```
raj (platform): Will produce: raw JSON export (gz), CSV manifest, and manifest.hash (SHA256). I'll put the SHA256 line like: `SHA256(evidence-INC-2026-0218-07.json.gz)= 3a7f...c9e2`.
sre_bot: runbook-export: evidence bundle job queued (job_id=jb-3325-01).
elaine (secops): For chain-of-custody, include who downloaded the bundle and when. Raj, can you add an actions.log with `user,action,timestamp,ip` from artifact store?
raj (platform): Yep. Also we should include the internal approval thread (redacted PII) — I'll add a PDF of ticket ENG-6421-redacted.
simon (compliance): Auditor also requested proof of key rotation policy enforcement around that time. Provide rotation timeline and whether this CMK had any pending rotations.
auditor_jane: If possible include a short note about ephemeral grant governance — which SOP triggered the grant and where the approval lives. That helps with control mapping to CC6/ISO A.9.4.
elaine (secops): Action list: (1) raj: produce exports + hashes + actions.log; (2) simon: attach approval artifacts and control mapping doc; (3) I will draft an auditor cover note mapping artifacts to SOC2 control IDs.
raj (platform): ETA 09:00 PT tomorrow. I'll post the upload link in this thread and ping when job completes. :thumbsup:
elaine (secops): Thanks — please use the evidence bucket `s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0218-07/` and set object lock retention = 30d. Auditor: we'll share pre-signed download with checksum.
auditor_jane: Sounds good. For the hash, I can ingest SHA256 or SHA512. SHA256 is fine. :eyes:
elaine (secops): Noted. tagging @sre_bot to ensure retention policy set after upload.
sre_bot: retention policy applied to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0218-07/ (retention=30d, retention_mode=GOVERNANCE).
raj (platform): Upload complete. Objects: evidence-INC-2026-0218-07.json.gz (sha256: 3a7f...c9e2), actions.log.csv (sha256: b12a...77ff), tickets-redacted.pdf (sha256: 8c2d...aa11). Pre-signed link: https://evidence.redwood.example/s/INC-2026-0218-07.tar.gz?sig=xxxx (link expires in 7 days).
elaine (secops): I'll attach the auditor cover note and control crosswalk in the bucket and mark the ticket resolved once auditor confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:
auditor_jane: Downloaded and checksum verified. Appreciate the manifest — will follow up with any clarifying Qs.
elaine (secops): Great, closing loop here. If any additional extracts needed, let me know and we can run targeted SIEM queries. :handshake:
